before_metrics.comment: New direction after momentum/expectation/ranking lines closed. exp-20260601-006 showed 5d momentum (RS, 20-60d formation) weak on broad universe; this tests the documented complement (short-horizon reversal) on the same broad universe.

change_summary: Tests cross-sectional short-horizon reversal on the broad 1446-ticker all-windows-full-liquid warehouse universe with a one-day skip (formation ends T, holding measured T+1->T+1+H) to remove bid-ask-bounce, a t-stat on the daily long-short series, a 0.70pct round-trip cost adjustment, a formation{1,3,5}xhold{5,10} grid, and per-window robustness. Result: reversal REJECTED -- every cell's losers-minus-winners skip-day forward return is negative (winners beat losers = short-horizon CONTINUATION). Incidental: short-formation (5d) winners continue over 10d (top quintile +1.34pct/10d, winners-minus-losers +1.16pp gross, 3/3 windows, t=2.15 for f5_h10; t=1.81 for f3_h10). Reported as a pre-registration-worthy lead, NOT promoted: marginal under multiple testing (6 cells, Bonferroni floor |t|>=2.64), thin net of cost (~+0.46pp/10d long-short), is-it-incremental-over-core-momentum untested, only 10d hold works.
decision_rule: A formation/hold cell qualifies as reversal only if its daily losers-minus-winners skip-day forward return has t>=2, a monotonic losers>...>winners ladder, majority-positive windows, AND a positive mean net of 0.70pct round-trip cost. Accept if >=1 cell qualifies. Reject if primary f5/h5 gross long-short <= -0.70pct (continuation). Else observed_only.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Do recent short-horizon losers bounce (cross-sectional reversal) on the broad universe, net of costs and a skip-day?
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260601-006 (broad-universe momentum weak); exp-20260601-003 (component decomposition). No prior reversal test in repo.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Past-return formation quintile vs skip-day forward return (reversal direction).
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Losers-minus-winners daily long-short t>=2, monotonic, majority windows, positive net of 0.70pct cost.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: warehouse all_windows_full_liquid, skip-day forward returns, formation/hold grid, t-stat. 9 unit tests.

hypothesis: Short-horizon cross-sectional reversal: on the broad 1446-ticker all-windows-full-liquid universe, the biggest 1/3/5-day losers out-return the biggest winners over the next 5-10 days (skip-day), with a losers-minus-winners daily t>=2, monotonic, majority-positive windows, surviving a 0.70pct round-trip cost.
next_evidence_needed: Reversal is not a usable edge on this universe (rejected). The only positive lead is incidental short-formation (5d) continuation at 10d hold; a clean follow-up must be a SEPARATE pre-registered experiment: long-only top-quintile of 5d winners 10d hold; a hard double-sort test of whether it is incremental over the core's existing momentum/breakout entry; a one-round-trip long-only cost model; and more out-of-sample windows since t=2.15 fails a 6-test Bonferroni floor (>=2.64).

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: no_reversal_only_continuation. The sign is continuation, not reversal; only the 10d cells reach |t|~2 and fail the multiple-testing floor.
